title: Larian Kita Jubli Perak 2026 Review: Klang's Silver Jubilee Community Run
seo_title: Larian Kita Jubli Perak 2026 Review | Klang Selangor Malaysia
meta_description: Larian Kita Jubli Perak 2026: October 10 at Stadium Sultan Suleiman, Klang. 21K, 10K, 3K from Eventique Management with registration open from RM39.
dek: Set for 10 October 2026 at Stadium Sultan Suleiman in Klang, Selangor — the silver jubilee edition. Three distances with registration open from RM39. A Klang community race with budget-friendly pricing.
verdict: Larian Kita Jubli Perak (Our Silver Jubilee Run) is a Klang community race produced by Eventique Management, anchored at Stadium Sultan Suleiman. Three distances (21K, 10K, 3K) with registration open from just RM39 — one of the most affordable half marathons on the Malaysian calendar. Klang is Selangor's royal town, known for its bak kut teh, its historic railway station, and the Klang River. A budget-friendly, community-flavoured race for Klang Valley runners.

sections.heading: Klang: Selangor's Royal Town
paragraphs: Klang is Selangor's historic royal town, roughly 30 minutes southwest of Kuala Lumpur. [1] Stadium Sultan Suleiman provides a proper sports-venue race hub. The silver jubilee theme adds a commemorative element to the race experience. At RM39 for the 3K up to RM99+ for the half, it's one of Malaysia's best-value road races.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: A budget-friendly Klang community race with open registration. 10 October 2026 at Stadium Sultan Suleiman. [1]
